title: Ensure cell broadcast alerts cannot be easily muted
description:
Currently cell broadcast messages can fail to produce feedbackd alert sounds in at least two ways:
 
 1. Phosh sends the alert event to feedbackd with its `mobi.phosh.Shell` app-id. The same app-id profile is also used for shell feedback events like haptics on window closing etc. and the user may have set the profile to 'silent' to avoid these. The silent profile also silences the cell broadcast alerts.
 2. The main volume may be set to zero causing the feedbackd alert to be silent.

If I've understood correctly, using cellbroadcastd directly (#1315) could help with having separate app-ids for shell feedback events and cell broacast messages.

As for the zero volume problem, the feedbackd interface could perhaps gain a new 'alert' hint, which would override a low volume setting with a higher one. The volume override should probably be opt-in with a configurable override volume level.

title: cellbroadcast: Use cellbroadcastd
description:
Once cellbroadcastd grows a [monitor mode](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/devrtz/cellbroadcastd/-/merge_requests/40) we want to pull messages from it (rather than listening to MM) as cbd then becomes the only source of truth, allowing it to delete the messages from MM after reception.

This avoids the CBM showing up multiple times when the user e.g. logs back in without MM restarting.

description:

* [ ] When touching on an app so it becomes maximized we sometimes have a bit of wiggling (as seen in the end of your video) which happens because the app overlay shows a non maximized frame after the app itself is already visible fullscreen. We should be able to drop that. (We need to make sure we never show a thumbnail once the bottom bar already reached unfolded state)
* [ ] When pulling up the bottom bar we have some flicker as the overviews background starts to alpha blend just a little bit before bringing up the thumb. We want to get them in sync (don't start the toplevel's background blend before the thumbnail-overlay is mapped).
* [x] When launching an app from the app-grid we show the thumbnail-overlay that then fights with the launch splash. !1950 helps here and we could also look into !1264 while at that.
* [x] Move animation to compositor for better performance / higher framerate (inspired by https://gitlab.gnome.org/World/Phosh/phosh/-/merge_requests/1944)

title: calendar-server: build fails with libical 4
description:
Note: this report and the fix in the linked merge request were prepared
with the help of an AI assistant (Claude Code) and reviewed and
build-tested by me. If you'd rather fix this yourselves without looking
at AI-assisted code, everything you need is in this description; the
code itself is only in the MR, so you can skip it.

# What problem did you encounter?

calendar-server no longer compiles against libical 4.0 (libical-glib
4.0.7), which is being rolled out in Fedora 46 / rawhide. Current main
(0.59~alpha1) is affected, not only 0.57.0.

## How to reproduce?

Build phosh against libical 4.0 / libical-glib 4.0.

## What is the (wrong) result?

```
calendar-server.c:162:32: error: passing argument 4 of 'get_time_from_property' from incompatible pointer type [-Wincompatible-pointer-types]
```

(likewise at lines 189 and 197)

## What is the expected behaviour?

It builds. In libical-glib 4 the `i_cal_property_get_*()` getters take a
`const ICalProperty *`, so they no longer match the `get_prop_func`
parameter of `get_time_from_property()`, which still expects a non-const
one. gnome-shell's calendar server, which this code derives from,
handles the difference with a callback type that depends on
`ICAL_CHECK_VERSION(4, 0, 0)`.

# Which version did you encounter the bug in?

- [x] I compiled it myself: Fedora's 0.57.0 package in a rawhide mock
  chroot with libical 4.0.7 from side tag f46-build-side-158330; main
  has the same code.

title: missing standard place to change default suspend setting for devices that don't need suspend
description:
The discussion started on distribution level downstream here:

https://gitlab.nura.eco/nura/pmaports/-/merge_requests/9832

and as you can notice during the conversation has been mentioned to involve upstream to know the best practice to solve this kind of issue

I try to recap: for the `motorola-dubai` device Gnome set suspend as default setting but it is not the best setting. The reasons are three: one is that many apps are not ready for suspend and `gnome-clocks` is just an example... but this is true for most phones.

Another reason to avoid the suspend as default option is this issue: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gnome-settings-daemon/-/merge_requests/481

But the 3rd reason for me is the most important: `motorola-dubai` has a great battery life even without using suspend!

After the merge of this https://github.com/sc7280-mainline/linux/pull/42 I risk to say that motorola-dubai is the first linux phone that can stay in idle for up to 70 hours even without suspend :)

As a first solution as you can check on the first link I've suggested a per device setting on distribution level (on Nura). But it is also true that in the future Mobian or other distro will require something similar...

Is distribution level the best place for that setting? Do you suggest another solution upstream or other best practice?

Enrico

title: phosh-session: set XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP/XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP when started without a display manager
description:
`phosh-session --help` says it can also be run from a tty, and greetd's `initial_session` (autologin) runs it directly too. In both cases nothing sets `XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP` / `XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP`: a display manager would take them from `DesktopNames=Phosh;GNOME;` in `phosh.desktop`, but `phosh-session` itself does not.

The session then silently loses everything that depends on those variables. What I measured on a PinePhone Pro (DanctNIX Arch image, phosh 0.57.0, greetd + phrog with `initial_session = phosh-session`):
- the Phosh-only GSettings override shipped by phosh, `[org.gnome.desktop.sound:Phosh] theme-name='phosh'` (`00_mobi.Phosh.gschema.override`), is not applied: `gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.sound theme-name` returns `'freedesktop'` in the session, `'phosh'` with `XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=Phosh:GNOME`. With the freedesktop theme feedbackd finds no `phone-hangup` sound, so there is no hang-up tone after calls (`gsound-play -i phone-hangup`: "File or data not found");
- the Settings (gnome-control-center) icon disappears from the app grid; on an earlier install with the same autologin setup the journal showed "Running gnome-control-center is only supported under GNOME and Unity, exiting";
- `loginctl show-session -p Desktop` is empty.

Logging in through the phrog greeter instead (which sets the variables) everything works; adding `~/.config/environment.d/10-xdg-desktop.conf` with `XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=Phosh:GNOME` and `XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP=phosh` fixes the autologin case (feedbackd then runs with `XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=Phosh:GNOME`, Settings icon back, hang-up tone back).

Suggestion: set defaults in `data/phosh-session.in` when they are unset, e.g.

```sh
export XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP="${XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP:-Phosh:GNOME}"
export XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP="${XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP:-phosh}"
```

I can open a merge request with that if you think it is the right place.

(Disclosure: I investigated this with the help of an AI assistant; the measurements above come from my phone.)

title: Make orientation setting persist across restarts and when between sensor being available / unavailable
description:
Environment: phosh/phoc v0.25.2, pureos10, Librem 5, Mobile Phone.

Maybe related to issue #754

Steps to repeat:

1. open quick settings panel swiping down
2. make sure the HKS switch is on (device power off) for wifi, camera/microphone, so only wwan 4G is running,
3. long press orientation to switch it to manual showing "Portrait"
4. turn HKS on for wwan powering down the modem,
5. this activates L5 lockdown mode which turns off the auto rotate sensor and changes the quicksetting for screen rotate to "Off",
6. turn off the HKS which powers on the wwan modem, 
5. Observe once 4G is back up and connected the Orientation quick setting still shows "Off"

What it should be showing is last used setting which could be either "Off", "Portrait/Landscape", or "On" for autorotate. In the above example it should switch to Portrait manual.

![persistentOrientation](/uploads/824d407cecc9f750358acb22ba6ede90/persistentOrientation.png)

![persistentorientation2](/uploads/4dac868efa0fab280729248c574ab8bd/persistentorientation2.png)

This story could be expanded or used to build automated test cases to make sure all quick settings are presistent especially after power cycling, phone restart, phone running out of battery completely, exiting lockdown mode, after resume from suspend, or when phosh shell crashes and restarts. Did not test other quicksettings to see if issues such as this one exist.

Additional Tests done:
Test2
Setup: wwan power off, wifi power off, camera/microphone power on, rotation on portrait manual, rotation sensor on.
Observation: when switching on HKS for camera powering off the camera/microphone the L5 is entering lockdown mode, however the rotation quicksetting button does not switch from portrait manual to "Off" indicating the sensor may still be on, while it is not,.

In this case the user can still manually rotate the screen in lockdown mode (which is desirable).

title: LLM policy
description:
Sorry for bringing up a potentially contentious topic, but I'm wondering if Phosh has any sort of LLM or generative AI policy for contributions. [I couldn't see anything here](https://gitlab.gnome.org/World/Phosh/phosh/-/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). I know that [some GNOME projeects ban LLM use](https://www.phoronix.com/news/Gedit-50-Released).

I'm always concerned personally when I see FOSS projects inject LLM output directly into code or documentation. (That doesn't include whenever an LLM was involved to find info or to locate bugs during development, as long as it wasn't used to write the fix for located bugs.) Simply due to the situation around that still being so unclear, and because I'm not a fan of taking parts from other projects without attribution, which [that seems to unavoidably involve](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3543507.3583199). So I gravitate to software where there is less of that going on, if that makes sense, at least when I happen to have the privilege to be able to choose.

Anyway, I realize each project has to decide this for themselves.  And of course you don't owe me an answer, I just thought it hopefully wouldn't hurt too much to ask. If this is too off-topic or you don't want to answer or I asked in the wrong place, please feel free to close this issue.

title: Unlock SIM-card with OSK in PIN (digits) mode
description:
Currently when phosh unlocks the SIM-card, the numeric PIN is queried with an entry with an `input-purpose` property set to `password`. This causes the OSK to open with a normal keyboard mode (letters etc.). Since the SIM-card PIN can only contain digits, this is slightly inconvenient.

GtkEntry also has a `pin` mode where only digits are allowed, but the characters are hidden. Would it make sense to add a mode to `PhoshSystemPrompt` which prompts for numeric PINs with this mode?

title: Splash stays up to full timeout when app never sends its startup_id back
description:
Compositor only receives the launcher's launched event; the client's startup_id event never arrives. The splash is only torn down on app-ready, so it lingers 5s / 27s / 30s until the startup timeout fires app-failed — regardless of how fast the window actually appears.
StartupNotify=false "fixes" it only because it disables the splash entirely, not because startup is faster.
PhoshToplevelManager already detects the app presenting a toplevel (remove_from_launching) but the splash isn't tied to that. Suggested fix: close the splash when the toplevel appears, not only on app-ready/app-failed.

title: caffeine: Allow to configure idle vs suspend
description:
We should add prefs plugin that allows to configure whether we want to inhibit idle or suspend (had that on my list since some time but lets have an issue here as well in case someone wants to pick it up). Both are valid but somewhat different use cases (e.g. package installation vs. don't blank in presentation mode).

The current discussion in https://social.phosh.mobi/@phosh/statuses/01K4ZEYYZ5GXTQ0P06APSZAMN7 shows both use cases are being used :thumbsup:  and ppl sometimes don't notice the difference and thus don't think about fixing the app giving us a better use experience in the long run. Maybe we also need to make the current active inhibitors taken by apps easier to discover so one knows better if the app does the right thing (we could show that info e.g. in the mobile settings prefs plugin panel that can be launched from the caffeine QS status page?). That is separate from the adding the above option in the first place though.
